finding.text: The shots do not show the page that changed. `shots/` holds `…-sessions-v/` (the variants index, a plain prose page) and `…-sessions-v-classic/` (the OLD controls). Neither draws the slim header, so the sticky row, the Today/Filters menus and the phone first screen (first card within ~180 px) are unverified. `/framework/ai/sessions/` needs shooting at 400 and 1920, unscrolled and scrolled ~600 px.
The readme line was not changed (requirements, "Done means": `sessions/readme.md` "How data is read" says one sticky header + Filters menu + v/classic). The diff has no readme.md change.

The header's `top` is `var(--sessions-header-top, 0)` and nothing in the diff sets `--sessions-header-top`, so it sits at 0. The ask was "under the site's top tabs, not behind them". The diff does not show that it clears the tabs (sessions.css, `.sessions-header`).

`overflow: visible` on the clipping ancestors is added only under `max-width: 40rem`. On desktop the old clipping ancestor may still be the header's scroller, so it may not stick at 1200 and above. Unverified, since there is no shot of the real page.
On a phone the PageNav links and the left nav are hidden and moved into the Filters menu. That fits the ask, but nothing shows the menu fits a 390 px screen (`max-block-size: 80dvh`).
The totals line and the count badge were cut. The brief allows this.

A doc is now stale: `ai/sessions/doc/live/grid-loading.md` line 5 still says "the window starts at the 1st of this month" and "moving the **From** box". The list now opens on Today, and the From box lives inside the range menu under "Custom…" (`pick_range`, diff line 94). `doc/views-plan.md` line 36 also points at the old `today` button (`:136`), which only v/classic draws now.

The review shots in `shots/` are of `/sessions/v/` (the variants index) and `/sessions/v/classic/` (the old layout), not the page that changed. This is the second time: review.mjs picks the pages from the new files in the diff and misses `/framework/ai/sessions/`. The changed page is judged here from the minion's own shots in the task folder (`shot-390*.png`, `shot-1920*.png`), which cover the brief's widths and scroll states.

The brief says the default range is Today (requirements, "Today ▾"). The code does default to Today (`fallback = Day.of(today)`, diff line 31), but every shot shows "This month ▾". The log calls the 199 px measurement "today-view", so it was taken in a different state from the shots. No shot shows the default.

The brief asked for two row counts that differ when "show closed" is toggled. The log has 88 → 88 for show closed (no closed sessions in the data) and 88 → 388 for a routine-kind chip ("clarity check"), not a role chip. So show closed is not proven to still work.

Smoke: FAIL on `/framework/ai/sessions/` in the worktree, 2× 404 on the generated `session-tree.json` and `session-index.json`. The log says the worktree lacks these generated files and there are no JS errors. Re-run smoke after the merge.
The new constructor option `classic: true` and the `data_url` getter are not mentioned in `ai/AISession/readme.md`. `ai/sessions/readme.md` does name v/classic.
At 1920 the search box stretches about 800 px between the two buttons (`shot-1920.png`, top band). The brief said "narrower". It is narrower at 390.

Inside the Filters menu at 390, the routine and role chip rows run off the right edge ("$0.37" and the role chip are cut off; `shot-390-filters.png`, middle). These are the existing nowrap scroll rows, but nothing in the shot shows they scroll.
